word_translation_en: to look after; to take care of; to concern (oneself) with
sentence_example: Sie muss sich um die Katze kümmern.
sentence_example_translation_en: She has to take care of the cat.
typical_collocations: sich um jemanden kümmern; sich um ein Problem kümmern; sich rührend kümmern
usage_comments_en: The reflexive verb 'sich kümmern um' (+ accusative) is extremely common and translates to 'to look after' or 'to take care of'. In its non-reflexive, transitive form ('Das kümmert mich nicht'), it means 'to concern' or 'to matter to'.

word_translation_en: to grieve; to trouble; to sadden
sentence_example: Seine schlechte Gesundheit bekümmert mich sehr.
sentence_example_translation_en: His poor health troubles me greatly.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Его плохое здоровье меня очень беспокоит.
sentence_synonym: Seine schlechte Gesundheit betrübt mich sehr.
typical_collocations: jemanden zutiefst bekümmern; sich bekümmern um; bekümmert sein über
usage_comments_en: 'Bekümmern' is a transitive verb that belongs to formal, literary, or archaic registers. It means to cause sorrow or worry. Today, the adjectival participle 'bekümmert' (worried, anxious, sorrowful) is used much more frequently than the active verb.

sentence_example: Sie hatte viel Kummer in ihrem Leben.
sentence_example_translation_en: She had a lot of grief in her life.
sentence_example_translation_ru: У нее было много горя в жизни.
sentence_synonym: Sie hatte viele Sorgen in ihrem Leben.
typical_collocations: Kummer bereiten; Kummer haben; großer Kummer; Liebeskummer haben
usage_comments_en: 'Der Kummer' (masculine, usually singular) refers to persistent emotional pain, worry, or sorrow. A very common specific compound is 'Liebeskummer' (heartbreak/lovesickness). Note the common collocation 'Kummer bereiten' meaning 'to cause worry'.

word_translation_en: to waste away; to wither; to atrophy; to stunt
sentence_example: Ohne Wasser verkümmern die Pflanzen schnell.
sentence_example_translation_en: Without water, the plants wither quickly.
sentence_synonym: Ohne Wasser gehen die Pflanzen schnell ein.
typical_collocations: geistig verkümmern; emotional verkümmern; Muskeln verkümmern; Talente verkümmern lassen
usage_comments_en: 'Verkümmern' is an intransitive verb conjugated with 'sein'. It is used both literally (e.g., muscles atrophying, plants withering) and figuratively (e.g., social skills or talents wasting away due to lack of use or nourishment).

word_translation_en: caretaker; nurturer; troubleshooter; person who takes care of things
word_translation_ru: опекун; заботливый человек; тот, кто решает проблемы
sentence_example: In unserer Abteilung ist er der Kümmerer für alle technischen Probleme.
sentence_example_translation_en: In our department, he is the troubleshooter for all technical issues.
sentence_example_translation_ru: В нашем отделе он — человек, решающий любые технические проблемы.
sentence_synonym: In unserer Abteilung ist er der Betreuer für alle technischen Probleme.
typical_collocations: ein geborener Kümmerer; der Kümmerer im Team; als Kümmerer auftreten
usage_comments_en: 'Der Kümmerer' (masculine) is a modern, colloquial, and often business-oriented term for a person who actively takes initiative to resolve issues, help people, and keep things running smoothly. It carries a positive, hands-on connotation.

sentence_example: Er verdiente nur ein kümmerliches Gehalt.
sentence_example_translation_en: He earned only a meager salary.
sentence_synonym: Er verdiente nur ein erbärmliches Gehalt.
typical_collocations: ein kümmerliches Dasein fristen; ein kümmerlicher Rest; kümmerliche Ergebnisse
usage_comments_en: 'Kümmerlich' is an adjective that describes something insufficient in quality, size, or quantity. It often expresses pity or contempt. It is very frequently used in the set phrase 'ein kümmerliches Dasein fristen' (to eke out a miserable existence).

sentence_example: Sie ertrug alle Kümmernisse des Lebens mit Geduld.
sentence_example_translation_en: She bore all the afflictions of life with patience.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Она с терпением переносила все жизненные невзгоды.
sentence_synonym: Sie ertrug alle Sorgen des Lebens mit Geduld.
typical_collocations: die Kümmernisse des Alltags; Kümmernisse ertragen; schwere Kümmernisse
usage_comments_en: 'Die Kümmernis' (feminine, plural: Kümmernisse) is an archaic, poetic, or elevated word for sorrow or hardship. In modern everyday German, it is virtually obsolete and has been entirely replaced by 'Kummer' or 'Sorgen'.
